title: Requirements-Based Test Generation: A Comprehensive Survey
abstract: arXiv:2505.02015v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As an important way of assuring software quality, software testing generates and executes test cases to identify software failures. Many strategies have been proposed to guide test-case generation, such as source-code-based approaches and methods based on bug reports. Requirements-based test generation (RBTG) constructs test cases based on specified requirements, aligning with user needs and expectations, without requiring access to the source code. Since its introduction in 1994, there have been many contributions to the development of RBTG, including various approaches, implementations, tools, assessment and evaluation methods, and applications. This paper provides a comprehensive survey on RBTG, categorizing requirement types, classifying approaches, investigating types of test cases, summarizing available tools, and analyzing experimental evaluations. tldr: 本文全面综述了基于需求的测试生成（RBTG），系统分类了需求类型、方法、测试用例和工具，并分析了其应用领域，强调其无需源代码即可与用户需求对齐的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of requirements-based test generation (RBTG), systematically categorizing requirement types, methods, test cases, and tools, while analyzing its application domains, highlighting its advantage of aligning with user needs without source code access.
